tweet_text:
turning this into a little tool, kunstkammer, that shows an entire folder of files on one page without scrolling 🌿
kunstkammer: art chamber, a cabinet of wonders; to see everything at once and let your eyes wander, finding the connections 🪸

available for subscribers <3

references.name: Suzuki Harunobu
references.evidence: A Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print featuring two women and a lantern, signed by Suzuki Harunobu on the bottom left, is displayed in the preview panel.

references.name: Wunderkammer (Cabinet of Curiosities)
references.evidence: A classical painting depicting a cabinet of wonders containing globes, skulls, and specimens is used for the splash screen of the application.

references.name: Claude
references.evidence: A card in the grid is titled 'claude soul document'.

references.name: Jakob Nielsen
references.evidence: A text card in the interactive grid references a 'multimedia and hypertext Article by Jakob Nielsen'.

references.name: Walter Ong
references.evidence: A text card in the interactive grid is titled 'Walter Ong and Writing'.

result.one_line: A product demo of Kunstkammer, an interactive tool designed to visualize an entire folder of files on a single, non-scrolling grid with immediate side-by-side previews.
